text: This report provides information on non-union employee separation costs. The Auditor General's 2014 work plan included a review of the City's non-union employee separation costs, and the review affirmed that separation costs have been awarded in accordance with City policies, procedures and applicable legislation. The Auditor General recommended that separation costs continue to be monitored and these costs be reported out regularly. The City has statutory and legal obligations to provide separation pay to an affected employee when the employment relationship is terminated by the City without just cause. Administering separation payments for non-union employees whose employment is terminated without cause falls under the authority of the City Manager.
